display_long_description:
In this crafting experience, you step into the role of a weaponsmith. Clean & Restore forgotten weapons before selling them to customers! 

# 🗡️ RESTORE FORGOTTEN WEAPONS TO THEIR PRIME 🗡️
Find the correct tool and weapon part to do your job! 
 - Chip off the rust 🔨
[media] 
- Scrub away corrosion 🧽 
 [media]
- Wash away dirt 🪣
 [media] 
- Polish steel until it reflects the light!✨
[media]
 [media]

Your task is simple: give these weapons a second life.

# 🛠️ REASSEMBLE EVERY PART WITH SATISFYING PRECISION 🛠️
Carefully reassemble weapons parts, and sell them to the mysterious customers.

A cozy game with no pressure, just hands-on blacksmith experience focused on care, precision, and craftsmanship.
